items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: That was one pretty smart guy named Walter Fuller. Not the trumpet player but the arranger.

ctx.x: That was one pretty smart guy named Walter Fuller. Not the trumpet player but the arranger. He came walking through the street there and he was calling us fools to our face.
